text:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a weird mismatch in the console quota dashboard for requests flowing through the service-account exchange path. Org quotas look undercounted relative to project-level. Ran a quick query:
```sql
select origin, count(*) as cnt from requests where route = '/v1/generate' and ts > now() - interval '1 hour' group by origin;
```
results show lots of `unknown-origin` when token exchange is used. Anyone else?

Maria: I noticed a similar spike yesterday during the staging canary. Thought the intake sampler was dropping the origin header for delegated tokens.

Sam: Can we confirm if the auth-proxy is rewriting or stripping `x-origin` on exchange? We rolled a header-normalisation patch in the proxy canary last week.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed auth-proxy v1.42.3 to canary at 2026-03-15T21:10:00Z (:rocket:)

Jordan: Quick note — our telemetry pipeline has two sampling stages: intake sampling (default 10%) and billing-enrichment stage (full). If intake samples out before enrichment, enrichment never sees origin -> becomes `unknown-origin`. That would explain counts being shifted.

Rita: Two short options: 1) persist origin in the token claim at exchange time (so downstream stages can read it even if headers are lost) or 2) have proxy synchronously enrich requests with org/project mapping before sampling. Both have tradeoffs.

Alex: Persisting origin in the token sounds clean for attribution but tokens are ephemeral for the exchange flow — adds storage/indexing overhead. Synchronous enrich in proxy is simpler but adds latency on the hot path.

Maria: Could we do async enrichment? e.g., emit an enriched audit event on cache miss and reconcile counts in nightly job. UI would show an estimated live count and a reconciled count later. Might be acceptable for non-real-time dashboards but sucks for billing.

Sam: Billing accuracy is priority. What if we add a conservative canary: add an `effective_principal` attribute in telemetry that is set to token claim when present, otherwise proxy-enriched value; also include `attribution_confidence` = `high|low|inferred`. Console can show confidence.

Jordan: I like that. Also add a telemetry tag `attribution_source` with values `token_claim`, `proxy_lookup`, `inferred` so downstream aggregation can split by source before sampling.

Rita: I'll open an RFC/PR to add the `attribution_source` tag and a small schema change for `effective_principal`. Who owns the proxy change (cache lookup + header passthrough)? @Sam?

Sam: I can take the proxy change. Plan: small passthrough + LRU cache lookup for sa_id -> org/project; fallback to `unknown` with metric increment. PR today, canary next week.

Alex: Please also author a backfill/reconciliation job for the last 72 hours so billing doesn't surprise customers. Add a console flag for opt-in detection (rollout) so we can validate without flipping production billing.

incident-bot: incident-bot: SLA alert triggered at 2026-03-16T02:12:00Z — quota mismatch spike detected, oncall notified: @Sam

Jordan: Triage call? dropping 15m invite now.

Sam: Will own immediate triage and follow-up. I'll include telemetry queries and sample counts in the PR description.

Maria: Thanks — please add a small UI toggle in the console under Settings -> Telemetry to enable `show_effective_principal` so product can opt-in for the canary. Ideally also show a note about confidence and last reconciliation timestamp. :white_check_mark:
